title: 优选公寓搜索查询
problem_statement_md:
你想租一间公寓，中介提供了一个公寓表**Apartments**:

![](/content/assets/7c57fdc7de5fe1b93410.jpeg)

核心字段含义:
- `price`: 出租价格
- `status`: 出租状态，**Rented** 已出租，**Not rented** 未出租。

编写一个查询，输出价格大于平均价格且未出租的公寓，并按价从小到大排序。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Apartments[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You want to rent an apartment and have the following table named [b]Apartments[/b]: [img id="4535" width="100%"]
Write a query to output the apartments whose prices [b]are greater than the average[/b] and are also [b]not rented[/b], sorted by the 'Price' column.
[note]Recall the [b]AVG[/b] keyword.[/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
select * from Apartments
where price >= (select avg(price) from Apartments) and status = 'Not rented'
order by price
